prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Analysis reveals CWT_catboost as trend champion (1.0 correlation) and FT_catboost as seasonality champion (0.4049 correlation), with CWT_catboost also winning overall RMSE (374.81). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 4.13) and high seasonality variance (1.11) indicate STL-hierarchical stacking is optimal to exploit decomposition-aware combination. Concept drift detected suggests dynamic weighting over static ridge fitting.
